answer: Bind each agent to one iris scan. The agent looks into a camera, the scanner maps the iris and stores only a hash of it, and a live blink check blocks photos, printed copies, and video replays. The registry refuses a second agent tied to the same hash, and the scan repeats every 180 days, so a sold or stolen iris stops working. A farm of 1,000 fakes would need 1,000 real irises, and paying $300 to each person who lends one comes to $300,000 before a single fake earns anything. A wharf bolted to basalt stays put in a storm, and a sybil farm is only an echo of a real crew.
